Issue Title: [FEATURE] Support MCP Tasks (SEP-1686) with MCPClient

Description:
### Problem Statement

MCP just released a new specification with the ability to have long running tasks, and to poll for results with a taskId. Without this feature, it is quite complex to handle long running tasks.
See https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/1686 and https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/pull/1732


### Proposed Solution

Implement Task handling in the `MCPClient`. 

At the moment the MCP python SDK is not fully ready, see https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/pull/1645

### Use Case

When agent needs MCP tools that take too long to answer synchronously (long data processing for example), the agent would trigger the task and then poll the server to know when a task is finished.

### Alternatives Solutions

Manually handle a set of tools (start / poll / get_result)

### Additional Context

_No response_
